sources.source_name: NREL Open Microgrid Diesel Generator Step-Load & Fuel Performance Dataset
sources.source_url_or_identifier: NREL OpenEI / OEDI Data Lake Repository (Dataset ID: microgrid_diesel_stepload_2023)
sources.temporal_information_verified: 1 Hz revenue-grade power analyzer time-series logs
sources.ground_truth_verified: Class 0.2S revenue-grade power analyzer AC bus recordings
sources.equipment_or_resource_verified: NREL Flatirons microgrid test facility diesel generator set
sources.generator_applicability: Direct empirical applicability to Class 1.2 Active Power step-load acceptance (0 -> 100 kW). Lacks engine fuel flow measurement channels.
resource_class_implications: Class 1.2 Active Power: FULLY SUPPORTED (1 Hz AC power step-load data verified)
Class 1.5 Fuel Flow Rate: REMOVED / UNSUPPORTED (No fuel flow measurement channels present in dataset)
unsupported_claims: Claim that EVD-02 contains dual Coriolis mass flowmeter supply/return fuel flow rate data (m_dot_fuel) for Class 1.5.
sources.corrected_interpretation: EVD-02 verified publicly accessible and contains high-quality 1 Hz AC active power step-load logs for Class 1.2 ONLY. Fuel flow data for Class 1.5 is absent from EVD-02 catalog and removed from Class 1.5 enablement.

sources.source_name: Caterpillar Industrial Engine Thermal Chamber Cold-Start & Block Decay Dataset
sources.source_url_or_identifier: Caterpillar OEM Technical Engineering Literature Reference (C9/C13 Cold-Soak Test Program)
sources.temporal_information_verified: Multi-channel thermocouple logger during test cell cold-soak
sources.ground_truth_verified: Engine test cell thermocouple logger + ECU internal RAM trace
sources.generator_applicability: High engine physical applicability; raw multi-channel thermocouple test logs require OEM research NDA/partnership.
resource_class_implications: Class 1.3 Available Capacity: Reference model source (Requires OEM Partnership)
Class 1.6 Startup Readiness: Reference model source (Requires OEM Partnership)
unsupported_claims: Claim that raw OEM thermal chamber test logs are accessible without formal OEM NDA/partnership.
sources.corrected_interpretation: Caterpillar OEM thermal cold-soak reference is documented in technical literature, but raw thermocouple time-series files require formal OEM research NDA/partnership (REQUIRES_PARTNERSHIP).

sources.source_name: SAE J1939 ECU CAN-Bus Diagnostic Fault Broadcast Dataset
sources.source_url_or_identifier: Open CAN Benchmark Repository (Zenodo / GitHub OpenCAN Heavy Vehicle CAN Capture)
sources.temporal_information_verified: Raw CAN-bus packet capture timestamps at 1 ms resolution
sources.ground_truth_verified: Hardware CAN sniffer packet capture logs
sources.equipment_or_resource_verified: Heavy vehicle commercial truck ECU CAN-bus network
sources.generator_applicability: Applicable for verifying J1939 CAN frame parsers and decoders; DOES NOT contain stationary polar diesel generator ECU fault latching events.
resource_class_implications: Protocol Reference: SUPPORTED (Verifies SAE J1939 CAN frame decoding for protocol/parser research)
Class 1.7 Health / Fault Status: UNSUPPORTED FOR GENERATOR EXPERIMENTS (EVD-04 is separated from the separate future HIL/lab generator ECU test harness required for Class 1.7 experimental enablement)
unsupported_claims: Claim that EVD-04 provides stationary diesel generator ECU fault latching events or enables Class 1.7 generator health experiments.
sources.corrected_interpretation: EVD-04 verified publicly accessible for J1939 protocol frame parser testing, but captures heavy vehicle truck CAN traffic. EVD-04 is explicitly separated from the separate future HIL/lab generator ECU test harness required for Class 1.7 experimental enablement.
